propsVocabulary.body: the group's inner area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real label/control/help children are separate components)
propsVocabulary.state: validation state → one pa-form-group--* modifier (success | warning | error). svelte exposes it as `state`, keen as `validation`.
propsVocabulary.required: boolean → pa-form-group--required, the escape hatch for NON-native widgets (custom selects, image browsers) with no :required descendant. svelte `isRequired`, keen `is_required`.
propsVocabulary.horizontal: boolean → pa-form-group--horizontal (label inline-start, control fills the rest). svelte `isHorizontal`/`horizontal`, keen `is_horizontal`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only. The container is always a <div class="pa-form-group ..."> in both wrappers. The body slot is a plain text token so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not rich field content. A state modifier is present when a state is set, pa-form-group--required when required, pa-form-group--horizontal when horizontal. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-form-group block modifiers are exactly: success/warning/error (validation), required, horizontal — all claimed below. No pa-form-group__* element classes exist.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Container-content left out of this container-shell slice. These carry no pa-form-group class and don't affect the axis-1 sweep; recorded for reviewer orientation.
deferred.note-label: keen `label` attr emits a leading bare <label> inside the group (auto-styled by core — no pa-form-label class); svelte has no label prop. Container content, not the shell.
deferred.note-field: keen `field` auto-switches validation to error when the Phoenix field has errors; svelte has no field prop. Behavioural, no class of its own.
